description: List the scheduled INDEC releases (CPI inflation, EMAE activity, wages, trade, industry, construction, employment, poverty) between two dates, each with date, time in Argentina, report name, period covered and the series keys it updates. Use it to answer "when is the next inflation figure out" or to know whether a value is about to change. Defaults to the next 60 days from today. Only INDEC for now. Read-only, no side effects, no authentication. Rate limited to 60 calls per minute per IP. Data updates at most once per business day.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, Argentina time. Defaults to today.

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 60 days after from.

name: get_release_calendar
title: Get the official release calendar
